_: The one switch for the apps' links on the site. tools/apps_status.py writes the app cards and the community Slack links (working group, footer) in site/pointe/index.html from this file, and site/deploy.sh runs it before every deploy. Statuses: mac "coming-soon" | "open", iphone "opening-soon" | "open". While an app waits, its card offers the notify link, and a link already set here is labelled as opening soon. An empty slack_url hides both Slack links (an invite link can expire).
